extensionDescription.message: Reports possible email tracking. Optional manual VirusTotal lookups for links and attachment hashes with your own API key.

options_suspiciousHostsHint.message: Supports ** as wildcard. One per line.

options_supportText.message: If PixelGuard is helpful, you can buy me a coffee:

vt_summaryDescription.message: Manual checks for links and attachments

vt_intro.message: Manual reputation lookups for this message. No files are uploaded.

vt_settingsIntro.message: Optional manual lookups using your own API key. Opening messages or saving settings never sends a query.

vt_disclosure.message: When you request a lookup, PixelGuard sends your API key and the selected domain, full URL or attachment SHA-256 directly to VirusTotal over HTTPS. No email body or attachment content is uploaded. Full URLs may contain private identifiers; even hashes can identify known files.

vt_keyStorage.message: The key is stored locally in your Thunderbird profile, without synchronization or an encryption guarantee. It is excluded from PixelGuard exports and logs.

vt_terms.message: Public keys are limited to 4 requests per minute and 500 per day. Commercial products and certain business workflows are restricted; your use must comply with your VirusTotal license.

vt_keyReplacePlaceholder.message: Enter another key to replace the saved one

vt_keyEmptyHint.message: Your key will be stored locally when you save and enable the integration.

vt_keyHint.message: A key is already saved on this device. Leave this field blank to keep it; the saved key is never displayed.

vt_consent.message: I want to enable these manual transfers from PixelGuard to VirusTotal, as described above.

vt_enabled.message: Enabled. Only your explicit lookups contact VirusTotal.

vt_disabledSaved.message: Disabled. A key is saved locally.

vt_disabled.message: Disabled. Configure VirusTotal to enable manual lookups.

vt_noReport.message: No report available. This does not mean the item is safe.

vt_notSafe.message: Zero detections do not guarantee safety or absence of tracking.

vt_urlWarning.message: This exact URL will be shared with VirusTotal. It may contain personal identifiers or private access tokens. Consult only the domain if you do not want to share it.

vt_empty.message: No links or attachments available in this message.

vt_truncated.message: This message has too many items; only the first items are shown.

vt_error_generic.message: The lookup could not be completed. Please try again.

vt_error_disabled.message: VirusTotal is disabled. Enable it in settings.

vt_error_permission_denied.message: Permission was not granted. Enable the optional permissions in settings.

vt_error_invalid_key.message: Enter a valid VirusTotal API key, or replace the saved key.

vt_error_forbidden.message: Your key does not have access to this report. Check your VirusTotal license.

vt_error_no_message.message: Open a single email message first.

vt_error_stale_message.message: The message has changed. Close and reopen the PixelGuard panel.

vt_error_unavailable.message: The message or attachment is unavailable or could not be decrypted.

vt_error_too_large.message: Attachments over 50 MiB cannot be checked in this version.

vt_error_confirmation_required.message: Review and confirm the full URL before sharing it.

vt_error_rate_limit.message: Request limit reached. Wait at least a minute before trying again.

vt_error_daily_limit.message: Daily request limit reached. Try again later.

vt_error_network.message: Could not connect to VirusTotal. Check your connection.

vt_error_timeout.message: VirusTotal did not respond in time. Please try again.

vt_error_storage.message: Could not save the settings locally. Please try again.

vt_error_unauthorized.message: This action is not available from this page.

vt_error_report_expired.message: The report has expired. Request a new lookup.

vt_error_busy.message: Another request is in progress. Please wait.

vt_noSummary.message: No detection summary available. Open the official report for details.
